Saigon Cafe.text:
This was a great experience.  I had been wanting to visit after having a Mixed By Eddie cocktail at an event and loved it!  I purchased a bottle at the event and was sad when it was gone.  I read that Saigon Cafe served his cocktails that he was their mixologist. 

Finally made it in Thursday evening.  One of the staff welcomed us in and we advised we were there for cocktails so he got is settled in.  The bar is fairly small and so pretty, the whole place was very nice.  I was a little envious of the diners close to the window wall that was open to the beautiful night.  

We had already eaten dinner, so we sat at the bar and reviewed the cocktail menu.  Jimmy was behind the bar and he was fabulous!  He talked to us and the couple next to us the whole time and had a vast knowledge of the cocktails and ingredients.  I ended up with one cocktail and decide to order the Shrimp dumplings to give some food a try, too.  The drink was so good, a Cherry Rocher Old Fashioned that Jimmy assured me wouldn't be whisky forward and it was perfect!  Loved the short glass and large, square ice cube. 

I love pork Pot Stickers but hadn't had a shrimp dumpling before.  I will now order them again when I return to give more drinks and dinner a try.  They were just the right amount of dough to filling, nicely fried but still the dough texture.  I am a sauce person, and the accompanying sauce was perfect for the dumplings.

Great spot with street parking, a pretty interior, great appetizer, superb drink, and Jimmy was the star behind the bar. 

Also took home another bottle Made By Eddie.

Welcoming! Which is appreciated after having to fight with the parking on Euclid. I was greeted with a smile and seated promptly.  Lunch specials were tempting so I opted for the fresh spring roll with grilled salmon....knocked my socks off. Two large rice paper wrapped rolls filled with fresh vegetables & delicious grilled salmon portion.  The accompanying sauce was a great touch but not necessary because the roll itself packed a mean flavor punch.  

Moving on....the Pho was top tier. Opted for the vegetable version which is served in a chicken broth. Fresh, hot, flavorful & plentiful. Good Pho is hard to find around town these days; Saigon did NOT disappoint. 

~Christy approved.

Amazing egg rolls in town. Nice and clean restaurant with good customer service.
They have a bar with Asian drinks and coffee with bakery.

Came here with my wife for dinner. We were greeted and seated immediately. Our server was very pleasant and helpful with selecting items. This was my wife's first time here, but i've been here before and gotten Vietnamese coffee here and FELL IN LOVE. 

We ordered chicken wings, my main dish was seafood fried rice, and my wife got the lemongrass chicken. My seafood fried rice was just ok. My wife loved her lemongrass chicken. The chicken wings were delicious, just overpriced; $14 for 4 wingettes. Will still come back and try other food.
Food is great. I had the Com Chien and was delicious. Service is great and wait staff are very courteous.

I wanted to come here to get pho for a while. Finally we made it on the Lantern Festival. The place is packed and most tables are booked. We were lucky to get a small table without waiting.  The price seems a little high compared to with a few other  Vietnamese restaurants.  We ordered noodles and fried rice.  Portions were generous. I actually really like it so did my friends. I like it more than Pho Grand.  My friend got a big bowl of noodles and had so much beef! Great place!

This was a horrible disappointment.  We had come by last Wednesday after finding out the place opens at 4 PM, we figured we would come back by for dinner. The place is supposed to close by 9, and we arrived at 8:10, and I believe that the waitress didn't want to wait on us but basically turned us away.  When we asked about seating indoors because of the heat, she said they the kitchen closes at 8:15, but that we could order takeout? Seriously? It didn't make any sense so we left. Too bad because I would have liked to have tried Vietnamese food.

Perfect patio, INCREDIBLE service, and some dang good eats.

Saigon has been on the hit list for ages, finally, my craving has been satiated. Before I get to food I must share how superb the service was. We walked in and before we were greeted with words we were greeted with smiles. 3 workers raced to greet us and get us seated. They were polite, enthusiastic, and gave some great recs. I believe christina(hope im spelling that correctly) was our server. Absolutely phenomenal, soft spoken but convicted. Gave us quick service and helped us pace/decide on our meal!

The patio is awesome for people watching. It is peaceful, and the world moves a bit slower inside that fence.

Calamari, lemon grass chicken, salmon rolls. Get it all. The lemongrass chicken was a favorite. The sauce was slightly sweet, but not overpowering and super light. The mint lemon sauce on the calamari was perfect. 

I'd love to go back today, tomorrow, and for the rest of history
Everything!  Service, selection and location. So good I went 2x in one week. Not sure what else to add. Looking forward to going back again.

The best service - patio is very dog friendly and the staff clearly loves animals. My fav thing was the crispy spring rolls and the chicken wings. But honestly - such a beautiful and comfortable place to have dinner.

Sameem Afghan Restaurant.text: The food at Sameem is great, always fresh and flavorful. It's my daughter's favorite restaurant in St Louis and we've been there many times. They never disappoint. The prices are good too and servers are friendly.

It was good! Very unique experience. Food is kind of a blend of middle eastern and Indian and a bit of south east Asia. Not a very fancy place, in fact I was a bit confused when I entered the door. But the food was definitely with it. Street Parking is free after 5 on Friday night. Service was fast but they used disposable cups.

Sameem Afghan Cafe is known for serving up great halal food in the Grove. You can taste the authentic Afghan flavors in every dish, perfectly spiced, and beautifully presented. The lamb kabobs were tender and juicy, and the bolani was perfectly crispy and flavorful. The portions are generous, and everything tastes homemade with care and presented at an affordable coats. 
The inside is quaint and the staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely interested in ensuring you enjoy your meal. Whether you're a fan of Afghan cuisine or trying it for the first time, Sameem is a must-visit in STL for middle eastern food.

We've never had Afghani food before and we were not disappointed. We enjoyed the SLU special and chicken broast. Both were tasty and huge portions (which we finished).  Don't expect a 5 star ambiance   Rather, it's  a nondescript place that serves good food.
The best! Hands down, one of my favorite menus in all of St. Louis. These guys put their all into their dishes. Offerings are affordable and plentiful. You'll have leftovers for the next day!

I love Sameem's. Their food is fire and everyone that I have gone with loves it. Everything is tasty and delicious. I had Sameem cater a wedding event of mine and have gone to the restaurant on a number of occasions and thoroughly enjoy the food every time. The staff is so knowledgeable and kind. I can't wait to go back!

When we arrived at this restaurant, we honestly thought it was closed because there was not a soul visible in the window behind the counter or in the dining room.  The only indication that they were open was the "Open" sign and a bag with takeout food on the counter.  But there is a side dining room that's not visible from the entrance.  The decor is simple and a bit primitive.  The service was wonderful and the food was delicious and very plentiful.  We had leftovers for at least one more day afterward.  It was our first experience with Afghan food and we were not disappointed.  It's probably too primitive for anything romantic or a business meeting, but for casual dining it was great.

In a prior life, I lived off South Grand, we are practically every nationality had a restaurant.  Walking by many times, I would always see their sandwich board sign advertising, their lunch, special of butter chicken and chicken, tiki masala.  Eventually, I got curious and wanted to stop in to try that lunch special, and it was amazing!  From that point on I ate there many times until one day I saw they had closed.  I very disappointed, I realize that operating an ethnic restaurant within a sea of other ethnic restaurants is hard to compete.  After a while, I heard that they had relocated from Tower Grove South to Forest Park, Southeast, a.k.a. The Grove.  Very happy to hear, I stopped by several times after that. They no longer have the lunch special, but make it for me when I order off menu.  

If you're looking for ambiance, this isn't your place, but good food good service and kind ownership is more important to me

My second Afghan restaurant experience, with the first being Afghan Kabob House.  I liked the Kabob House slightly more for its dining atmosphere and spice variety, but both were excellent choices.  We had the Bolini, Lamb Shank and chicken beriani.  Good choices, but if you were sharing, I would only order one of them, since both the lamb and chicken had similar rice.  The server was excellent and the food arrived quickly.
Easy and quick place to get decent halal food. The butter chicken was a 3/5. The chicken tenders 3.5/5 . It's my go to place when I can't think of what to cook.

Tikka Tangy.text:
This is a new location for this chain. We came on a Saturday and it was packed, sadly it was also a training day for the team, so service was not good.

BUT the food is wonderful!

The exterior is mirrored and the signage is a temp one, so it was hard to tell if we were in the right place.

Once inside, we sat at one of the high top tables and got water. Disposable cups and we had to repeatedly ask for refills during our stay.

But that food!

We ordered 2 different appetizers and a pizza.

Only 1 app came out and the pizza showed up soon after. Both were flavorful and spicy! We had to ask for cutlery and then ordered a rose boba tea to try and have something to drink. (Again, water refills were tough to get, they were running around very busy!)

Turns out the rose and strawberry boba are the same, which was a surprise. Bill came out eventually and we paid at the table.

Suggestions to the owners/managers!

If you remove the high top table by the door (the one directly in the air vent that can't balance right) and added a station for people to get their own water, to go boxes and cutlery, you would save your team a lot of running around and let the customers handle it for them. 

I'd also suggest having 1 person dedicated as the food runner/dining room attendant, 1 on orders and everyone else in the kitchen.

Food was great and with a little training and tweets, this place will be around and successful for a long time!

Menu had all kinds of stuff to try, looking forward to another visit!

I've been curious about this place for a minute so I finally gave them a shot. Holy cow!! I love pizza and I love chicken tikka masala, so I tried the tikka masala pizza with chicken. The waiter was super helpful and suggested a few more toppings since it comes with 6 standard. He added green peppers, red peppers, onions, cilantro and tomatoes.
It was amazing!! Can't wait to try some more menu items.

Really cute spot in CWE with Indian and Middle Eastern food . I ordered the samosas and aloo tikki chat to go . They were delicious and perfectly spiced per my stated preference. Really hard to find authentic chat preparations outside India so I was thrilled! The server who took was order was very courteous and even offered me water though it was just a to go order . I will be back and try some more food .

I'm from California (but now stay in STL) & had 2 spots that I loved out there. One in Venice & the other in Pasadena. This spot beats both of them! The food was absolutely amazing and the staff is genuinely very nice. Tikka Tangy will definitely be a regular date night spot for me & my wife
Delicious food, huge portions for the cost, great location and walkable for any CWE resident. Will be coming back regularly!
The food was amazing and I wish I could eat this everyday. Naveen was so wonderful with helping us order! The tikka masala chicken pizza was life changing - yummy!

Went here yesterday with my mom . This place is a hidden jewel . The customer service was really good , the food was good and fresh . And I loved my mango smoothie . I ordered chicken masala . 

Mom had to use the bathroom which she said was very clean . The restaurant itself was clean . The ambiance was nice too. There were a lot of door dash orders and now I see why . 

I will definitely go back again .

What a pleasant surprise on a business trip!  Creative menu and very customizable, excellent quality and very attentive staff, all for a very reasonable price.  We will be back next time thru St. Louis!

Ordered the Butter Masala pizza and it was good. My gripes are they skimped on my pizza toppings that were included and eliminated others that should have been on the pizza. They give you up to 6 toppings for your pizza--there were no mushrooms or corn on my pizza at all, nor did they put extra cheese on it (I paid an extra $1.50 for the topping) plus I asked for the 'house spicy seasoning' on the side and it was not included in the box. This was my first time in and willing to try again if they pay more attention to detail when preparing orders.

They were busy when we went but they were still very nice and attentive. Communicated that they were really busy and catching up on orders and that it will take a little while to take our order. Which was okay because we were busy chatting anyways. The ambiance is nice and cozy inside.

The appetizers were great! We got the samosa Chana chat street food, cauliflower bites. Garlic and butter nans were great! 

For entrees we got butter chicken and paneer tikka masala. They were decent but not the best that I've had. Not as flavorful as these dishes usually are. 

I would come back and do recommend this place!
